name: job-mail-worker
description: Cloudflare Email Worker that sorts job-application mail: rejections and auto-replies out of the inbox, interviews flagged and pinged on Telegram

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

FORWARD_TO.description: Your mailbox. Everything lands here unless sorted elsewhere. Add it as a verified destination under Email Routing first.

FORWARD_ATTENTION.description: Optional. Offers, interviews, assessments and anything needing a reply go here, e.g. you+jobs-attention@gmail.com. Empty means FORWARD_TO.

FORWARD_ARCHIVE.description: Optional. Confident auto-confirmations and job-board noise go here, e.g. you+jobs-ack@gmail.com. Empty means FORWARD_TO.

FORWARD_REJECTED.description: Optional. Confident rejections go here, e.g. you+jobs-rejected@gmail.com. Empty means FORWARD_TO.

ARCHIVE_MIN.description: Classifier probability needed before mail leaves the inbox (0-1).

ATTENTION_MAX.description: Most probability the attention categories may share for mail to leave the inbox (0-1).

AI_MODEL.description: Workers AI model for classification (without TypeSafe) and Telegram summaries.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Bot token from @BotFather for pings and the weekly digest.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Optional. Telegram chat id that receives the pings.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Optional. TypeSafe key for the Jev classifier; Workers AI is used without it.
